test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.

Weren’t you informed about the new policies of hiring?

options.text: Was anyone informing you about the new policies of hiring?
Wasn’t anyone informing you about the new policies of hiring?
Didn’t anyone inform you about the new policies of hiring?
Hadn’t anyone informed you about the new policies of hiring?

solution:
The correct answer is "Didn’t anyone inform you about the new policies of hiring?"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The basic structure of these kinds of sentences:
 
 
• **Passive: Question word+ not + subject2+ subject1 + object.**
 
• **Active: Auxillary word +not+ subject1 + subject2**
 
• **​**Let's see an example-
 
 
• Beautiful giraffes roam the savannah. (Active voice)
 
• The savannah is roamed by beautiful giraffes. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer will be: *Didn’t anyone inform you about the new policies of hiring?*
